format: APNG, all captured frames, lossless normalized pixels
apngCompression: Lossless changed-pixel rectangles from each normalized captured frame. Every composited full frame remains pixel-identical; identical consecutive captured samples remain distinct frames with one unchanged real pixel.
temporalProcessing: Every captured sample retained, including identical consecutive images. Delays are close unsigned-16-bit rational representations. No decimation, inserted frames or interpolation. Browser preview only: source delays below11ms are extended to11ms to avoid Chromium's <=10ms-to100ms animated-image clamp. Original and adjusted intervals, affected frames and total extension are reported; original MP4 is unchanged.
spatialProcessing: Fixed crop spanning recorded native panel bounds at original display pixel scale; per-frame contentScale is reversed when ScreenCaptureKit resized its fixed capture surface. No generated UI, labels, icons, or decoration. Black fills only unavailable pixels outside the captured window or transparent panel pixels.
limitations: Source capture gaps are preserved. APNG playback may be scheduled or throttled by the viewer and does not prove production or browser render FPS. Losslessness is relative to the original-display-scale normalized frames before video/GIF compression.
